[[File:Fanlanden map.jpg|140px|left|link=The Ash Oath]]
The '''[[Ash Oath]]''' was sworn in the ash of the burned battlefield at the end of the [[War of the Unification]], and the peace it sealed has held four hundred years, save four. It bears '''ten seals — some say eleven.''' One old copy of the Chronicle carries a marginal note in a hand never identified: ''Count the seals.''
